, Soot.]] The Glades are a family living in a cottage in Lakeshire in Redridge Mountains. Shortly after the Third War, Robb Glade married Ceya Thorne after her husband, Greydon Thorne, suddenly left her after six years of marriage. She waited for two years before having the marriage annulled by Magistrate Solomon and married Robb, with whom she had initially two children. Robb also adopted Ceya's son, Aramar who fully embraced their relationship. Robb left his own cottage and forge and moved to Ceya's cottage and built a new forge alongside it. More than a year after the Cataclysm, Ceya was with Robb's third child.

Glory of the Raider (25 player) is a meta dungeon & raids achievement earned for completing the listed Wrath of the Lich King achievements. Until Patch 3.1.0, the achievement also rewarded the flying mount.

Unrivaled among engineering-created explosive devices, this is an enhanced version of the Goblin Sapper Charge. It follows the goblin principle of "maximum destructive ability, minimum self-preservation" seen in the side effects of other Goblin Engineering items.
Globes of Tumultuous Water is one of the Toshe Chaosrender's orbs, this one has the ability to create a water vortex. The vortex can be used to trap Swarming Serpents.

Glory of the Cataclysm Raider is a meta dungeon & raids achievement earned for completing the listed Cataclysm raid achievements. The achievement also rewards an epic flying mount, the Drake of the East Wind.

Glittering Amberflies are fireflies located in the Amberfly Bog in the Jade Forest. They are slain for their wings that give color to the Dream Brew.

Glory of the Thundering Raider is a meta dungeon & raids achievement earned for completing the listed Throne of Thunder achievements. The achievement also rewards an epic flying mount, the Reins of the Armored Skyscreamer.

Glix Grindlock is a goblin quest giver located at Gallywix Defense Post in Azshara. He is upset that the Enslaved Son of Arkkoroc are destroying all the mines. During the Legion Invasions, he defended his post.

Glory of the Orgrimmar Raider is a meta dungeon & raids achievement earned for completing the listed Siege of Orgrimmar achievements. The achievement also rewards an epic flying mount, the Reins of Galakras.

The Glopgut is a group of ogres at Glopgut's Hollow within the Twilight Highlands. They are led by Brogg Glopgut and Thog. After antagonizing the Thundermars for years, they kidnap Fanny Thundermar who frees herself during a raid to rescue her by killing her captors with her bare hands. They also used to cause many problems to the inhabitans of Humboldt's Stead before the town was destroyed by the Twilight's Hammer. Not yet having joined the Twilight's Hammer, the Twilight's Hammer gave the Glopgut the Light of Souls as a gift to root out infiltrators, though it seems to have been used as a nightlight. Perhaps ironically, the ogres were attacked by a member of the Horde disguised as a member

Gloaming Frenzies drop from Underlight Deepfeeder at the Gloaming Reef islands off the coast of Val'sharah. These fish can also be fished from pools of Frenzied Fish.

Glutton is a level 45 elite abomination mini-boss found in Razorfen Downs, created from the remains of Tartek the Enraged. He is a powerful melee fighter and repeatedly enrages with the emote "Glutton is getting hungry!" during the fight, attacking even harder. Glutton patrols the lower tier of Spiral of Thorns, and can be pulled without any adds if you wait for him to wander to an opportune place.

Gnomish Alarm-O-Bot summons Alarm-o-Bot, a guardian pet alarm-o-bot that lasts for 2 minutes or until destroyed. Note that as a malfunction, it sometimes displays the pulse animation without actually sending out a pulse. Like with many other mechanical devices (such as Target Dummy), when it expires, you can "loot the body" for some portion of the original materials.
Gnomish Net-o-Matic Projector casts a magical net on a target immobilizing them. When it backfires it will either net the caster or both the caster and target.

Gnomebots are types of robots manufactured by the mechagnomes on Mechagon Island. They have a one-eyed or two-eyed head, others have a tesla coil instead of a head, and some malfunctioning ones don't have a head at all.

These Gnomish Tools were originally transported on Daelin Proudmoore's fleet. After the fleet sunk, the tools could commonly be found underwater off the coast of Durotar. After the Shattering caused a tidal wave in the Great Sea, the tools have washed up on shore. They can now be found scattered in the sand and wrecked ships along the central beach of Durotar.

Goats are small livestock, mainly found in Pandaria, though native populations also exist elsewhere such as in Alterac Valley. Goat's milk is used to make cheese. Their fur can be used to make clothes, such as cloaks. You'll often find them perched high atop impossibly high and remote stone outcroppings. There are few creatures as sure of foot. It takes unflagging patience and a gentle touch to train obstinate mountain goats for riding. Although not as wise as the local frost wolves, the goats of Alterac willingly surrendered wool, milk, and sometimes even their life in return for the Frostwolf clan's protection.
In which you venture into the dangerous areas of Gnomeregan to help find a cure for the leper gnomes. Or perhaps just a new and powerful drink.

The Gnoll Punisher drops from Redridge Brutes in the Redridge Mountains. It has a small chance to drop from Ribchaser.
Gnomish Power Goggles continue the Gnomish Engineering tradition of high-level goggles, as opposed to the high-level helmets of Goblin Engineering.
.]] Gnomish copters are small gnomish flying machines capable of carrying goods with the grappling hook attached to their base. These lifts were first seen in Ulduar.
Go for the Throat is a passive specialization ability for Beast Mastery hunters, available at level 20.

__NOTOC__ The Gnomeregan Conjurors are two pairs of gnomes mages that can be found on the Alliance side of Stair of Destiny in Hellfire Peninsula. They first appeared during the Dark Portal Opens event, where they summoned Lord Marshal Raynor and his Stormwind Marshals. The first two gnomes have created a portal to Stormwind City where reinforcements arrive to aid in the battle against the Burning Legion. Stormwind Soldiers, Ironforge Paladins, Darnassian Archers, and Stormwind Mages, and from time to time, Justinius the Harbinger, all come out of the portal and rush to the base of the stairway to aid in the battle against the Burning Legion forces led by the Pit Commander. __NOTOC__ Gnoll Overseers are gnoll creeps that can be encountered in the Lordaeron Summer, Fall and Winter tilesets. They are the most powerful members of the gnoll creeps family.

The maniacal and brilliant Goblin Alchemists are masters of volatile chemicals, explosives and strange mechanical devices. Having constructed Zeppelins to soar above the battlefield, as well as inventing watertight pilot-shacks for use on the enslaved race of giant Sea Turtles, the Goblins have defied the very laws of nature. They also create the devastating explosives used by their cousins, the Goblin Sappers. The Alchemists take a peculiar delight in these intellectual endeavors that few understand, but all in the Horde respect the havoc that they produce.

Gnome Punting is a sport enjoyed by all walks of life in Azeroth. It is a test of skill, strategy, testosterone, manliness, cunning, guile and strength. Members of the Horde as well as the Alliance compete in this daring sport, often times against each other.

The gnomish starting experience takes place on the surface of Gnomeregan and at New Tinkertown in Chill Breeze Valley, in western Dun Morogh, a level 1-20 zone. After the political upheaval in Ironforge, the gnomes of Gnomeregan have started a daring campaign to retake their former capital. In the wake of Operation: Gnomeregan, survivors of the fallout make their way to New Tinkertown, the gnomes' foothold outside their captured city. Although work is now under way to retrieve and decontaminate irradiated survivors from Gnomeregan itself, another battle has ignited in Dun Morogh against one of Sicco Thermaplugg's henchmen, Razlo Crushcog. The gnomish adventurers are found by the Survivor Ass

The Gnomeregan Battle Suits are wearable bipedal steam-powered battle engines. Er, for the layman, they're armored suits with a steam engine. They're highly radiation-resistant, and very effective in combat. They are based on the crowd pummeler design.
Gnomeregan Satchel is a reputation reward; you must be with Gnomeregan to buy this item from at the Great Forge next to the flight-master in Ironforge for .

Goblin Admirers stand around on the southern coast of the island in the middle of Bilgewater Harbor, fawning over the painting skills of Sudsy Magee. When a player kills the Sudsy is painting, they will usually burst into tears and Sudsy will say something intended to console them.

The Gnomeregan Institute of Tinkering is a gnomish institute, presumably located inside Gnomeregan. Given the name, along with the general nature of gnomes, it is likely dedicated to science and engineering. Narain Soothfancy and Doctor Weavil were two of the students. According to Weavil's diary (which so far holds the only mention of the institute), Narain destroyed the curve on all of Weavil's exams, which caused Weavil to fail out of school. For that, Weavil became his archenemy.
Gob Squad Flares are provided for the following quests at the Shattered Strand in Azshara: *Extermination *Handling the Goods *Head of the Snake *Still Beating Heart *Ticker Required
Gnoll Decoys are a Darkmoon Faire product, like those used in Whack-a-Gnoll. Purchased by , he uses them when adventurers seek Justice (quest). Ripflesh drops their Crumpled Bill of Sale:
Gobble Strike is an ability used by turkeys during a Pet Battle.

The Gnomish Gearworks is a large garrison building that gives players different inventions with varying abilities, such as rocket packs and bombs. It also unlocks a siege engine that can be driven around Draenor once per day. The building is similar in use to the workshops of the older games.

The resourceful Gnomish Inventors have designed an amazing craft known as the Submarine. This watertight vessel can submerge beneath the waves and surreptitiously keep watch on enemy forces above the surface. The Gnomish Submarine is visible only to Towers, aerial forces, and other vessels that move beneath the waves. Using cunning and craft to carry out surprise attacks on more powerful enemies makes the Submarine an invaluable part of the Lordaeron armada.
__NOTOC__ The Gnoll Warlord appears in Misconceptions on the north-west island. He drops a Rune of Greater Healing when killed.

Goblin Bombers are goblins of Gadgetzan during the Legion Invasions. True to their name, they are bombardiers either flying bombers, engaging in dogfights with felbats and bombarding Burning Legion troops, or simply standing on their feet and throwing Shortfuse Special bombs at the demons. Sometimes their planes could be found crashed, with the pilots laying injured near the wreck. Saving them would improve the score of defense against the Legion.

Gnawer is one of several names for the rat pets kept by the Bluewax Ratcatchers in Candle Rock in Highmountain. Like the rest of the Bluewax, the rats are normally but turn while the player is wearing the Skull of Bossing Around, and while they have the "Friends For Life (Okay, Neutral)" buff.
Goblin Commoners are goblins located in the Steamwheedle Cartel settlements and Shattrath City during world events.
Gnomeregan Stealth Fighters are flying machines located in the Lost Isles. They are piloted by Alliance Paratroopers.
Gnomebot Pounders are steam armors located at Windshear Hold in the Stonetalon Mountains.
Gnomish Bombers are bombers located in the Stonetalon Mountains. They are piloted by Gnome Wing Commanders.

Goblin Construction Workers were goblins located in Orgrimmar, working on the Ring of Valor, a building in western Drag, the building that was taken over by the ethereals. They later appeared on the gate in the Valley of Strength.
__NOTOC__ Gnollfeaster is a tarantula located in Lakeridge Highway of Redridge Mountains.

The Gnomeregan Airmen are a group of gnomish pilots operating in Dun Morogh. They have a flight path through Coldridge Valley. Hands Springsprocket called them after Coldridge Pass collapsed and Milo Geartwinge came on his gyro to provide transport for the dwarven adventurer out of the valley.

Gnomeisium is a rare metal that can be found in trash heaps of Mechagon Island alongside Dalaranium and Suramarite. Moxie Lockspinner harvested them in order to sell them on the black market. It is named after the gnome race.
Gnashing Terrors are tentacles located in the Maw of Gor'ma in Ny'alotha, the Waking City. They will wait underground and burst forth when approached.
Gnomish Gyro-Engineers are gnomes located in Stormwind City during The Stormwind Extraction.
Gnoll Kindred Bracers drop from Redridge Thrashers in the Redridge Mountains.
Gnashing Horror is a jormungar located in Island Expedition.

__NOTOC__ Gold is a metal that can be mined. Mined from the rich earth of Azeroth and Lordaeron, this precious metal is commonly used in exchange for goods and services. As a rare substance that is always in short supply, gold must be dug out from the rock and soil within established gold mines. Many of these mines were abandoned when the orc raids began and the workers fled for their very lives. Since the beginning of the Second War, these sites are frequently operated while under the protection of military forces. Gold was scarce in Lordaeron, even in the height of the Alliance's power.
__NOTOC__ Gold Power Core is an engineering component created by engineers.
Goggeroc was an earthen summoned in the Stonetalon Mountains. He was worshipped by the Gogger kobolds. Mor'rogal wanted Goggeroc summoned and killed.

The Goggles of Gem Hunting are used to detect sunken treasure and gems off the coast of the Arathi Highlands. Constructed by Doctor Draxlegauge, Professor Phizzlethorpe empowered the goggles with an enchanted stone in a cave in Faldir's Cove.

Gods are vaguely defined in Warcraft. Gods can exert influence over several locations simultaneously, but the power of a god is limited. The Old Gods were imprisoned by the titan-forged and Wild Gods have been defeated. Nonetheless, an imprisoned, sleeping, or otherwise enfeebled god may still have an effect—conscious or not—on the god's surroundings. Certain gods have even been killed.

Goblin Sappers are goblins located in the southernmost building of K3 in the Storm Peaks. During Know No Fear, an army of them is deployed to destroy Garm. They seem well-equipped considering they are disposable suicide bombers.

Golems are constructs, magically wrought automatons of bones, flesh, metal, or stone and are generally thought to be mindless. They are built generally as guardians or protectors of a person, place, or thing. Most usually have Golem Oil flowing inside them like blood, but some are also mechanical.

The most feared soldiers of Ragnaros's elemental forces are the molten giants, and among them Golemagg the Incinerator is unrivaled for his sheer brutality and savage efficiency. So absolute is the molten behemoth's power that he has cowed two core ragers — offspring of the colossal beast Magmadar — which he now uses as pets. For this affront, he has earned Magmadar's eternal and unwavering ire, although the fearsome creature has yet to act on his savage impulses. Golemagg is a molten giant boss with 2 pet dogs, called Core Ragers, for guards of the Rune of Theri.

Goldenbough Pass is located in southwestern Eversong Woods between two mountain ranges. A road is paved through the pass connecting the Sunsail Anchorage and a tower overlooking the Scorched Grove.
Golem Skull Helm is a Level 51 quality Plate Helmet that improves Strength, Stamina and Dodge.

Gold Spamming is normally associated with unsolicited contact of players in World of Warcraft for the express purpose of selling them gold in exchange for real money. It can also include advertisements on fan sites related to the game. Some of the spam includes power leveling services in addition to gold. It is not uncommon for players to be spammed multiple times during a gaming session. Do not confuse this with a Gold Farmer which is a legal activity in World of Warcraft.

A gold seller is someone who sells in-game gold for real currency (€, $, etc.). Sometimes extended to cover someone who sells accounts or virtual assets (items). Gold selling and gold sellers are also sometimes known by the acronym RMT for Real Money Trading/traders. As gold sellers usually announce their prices, websites and similar services (such as power leveling) in chat channels, they are also often referred to as "gold spammers". The chat channel most used for this is the trade chat. As many players consider these "commercials" to be extremely vexing, there is made a number of addons to block them. Goldshire and Moonbrook is the eleventh mission of the Orc campaign in Warcraft: Orcs & Humans.
Goldsmith's street was a portion of Stormwind City during the First War. King Llane's forces, including mages, were able to repel the orc forces here.
The Golden Keg is the inn and tavern located in the Dwarven District in Stormwind City.
Goldtooth's Den is a small camp in Elwynn Forest located above the Fargodeep Mine. Prior to the Shattering, Goldtooth resided within the mine itself. He has since relocated right above it.
Gonzalez is a mastiff found in the Command Center in Stormwind City.

The Golden Pagoda is a subzone of the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Found between the two gigantic mogu statues overlooking the western half of the vale, this place once housed the Golden Pagoda itself. When the mogu invaded the vale, the pagoda became a meeting place for the Golden Lotus to enlist adventurers from the Horde and Alliance to aid them. Several important members of the Lotus were stationed here, including Leven Dawnblade, Rook Stonetoe, Sun Tenderheart, and Kun and Anji Autumnlight. When Garrosh Hellscream awakened the Sha of Pride, feedback from the event destroyed the Golden Pagoda and surrounding areas, killing many of the residents there. The Golden Lantern is the inn of the Shrine of Seven Stars and is found on the lower level of the area on the right side. To the center (and to the left) is the Emperor's Step, upstairs is the Chamber of Enlightenment, and outside is the Summer Terrace.

__NOTOC__ Golden Carp is fished from the waters of Pandaria. Unlike other Pandaren fish, it does not appear in any fishing pools but is the most common fish caught when fishing in any type body of water (ocean, river, lake, etc.). It is a cooking ingredient used in several recipes. They can also be purchased from Nam Ironpaw at Halfhill Market in Valley of the Four Winds; one Ironpaw Token purchases a Sack of Golden Carp which contains five of them.
Goldenback is a rare gorilla that can be found just to the east of the Unearthed Grounds in Stonetalon Mountains.

Golmash Hellscream, known as the Giantslayer, was the father of Grommash Hellscream and the father of the Hellscream name. His death came in battle, crushed to death in the jaws of a hulking gronn. But Golmash still found the strength to stab with his axe, Gorehowl, into the gronn's eye, bringing it down with him. When they fell, it was the gronn who died first. Putting Golmash's spirit to rest is the objective of the quest Golmash Hellscream (quest).
Golden Hooks drop from the aquatic beasts of Pandaria. They can also be found in Bloated Threshers during the Darkmoon Faire.
The Golden Arachnodrone is a mechanical spider found on Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh. Hunters may tame it, after using an Electrified Key and bringing it below 30% hp.

Golden Minnows has a chance to be fished up from the waters near Sha'leth in Suramar. They also drop from Magicus, summoned by the Glowing Fish Scale. It can either be turned in to Sha'leth to gain reputation with her, or be used as a currency for the wares she sells (which require reputation with her).

The Golden Throne of Dazar'alor, was the throne room of the King Rastakhan, and now is of Queen Talanji. It is the highest point of the city, located right above the Great Seal. The ruler's closest bodyguards and the Zanchuli Council are stationed here.
The Golden City Greatcloak is a quest reward from Deterrent.
Golden King is a lion located in the Trade District of Stormwind City.

The Goldsnuffle are a group of kobolds found in Neltharion's Vault in Highmountain.

Gold buying refers to an act in which a player trades real money (such as US dollar, Euro, etc) for the in-game virtual money (gold). This is conducted via third-party services. Blizzard does not offer any equal service. Several companies which offers this kind of service exist, often offering additional services such as power leveling, reputation leveling, profession leveling, etc. Most such companies (if not all) have their respective internet sites, each claiming to offer the best prices and performances. The Gordunni (or the Dire Maul Gordunni clan, the Gordunni Ogres, and the Gordunni clan of ancient Draenor) is an ogre tribe or clan based in central Feralas. Many have taken residency in the Ruins of Isildien in the High Wilderness as well as the foothills north of Camp Mojache, while the "upper class" is found in Dire Maul. Like most of their kind, Gordunni ogres are remarkably bloodthirsty and are comprised both of melee warriors and spell casters. Gordunni ogres have proven to be highly detrimental to the land of Feralas, desecrating its cultural treasures and despoiling its lush forests. The Gordunni Outpost is an area in the mountains north of Lariss Pavilion currently held by the Gordunni ogres. Their presence has wilted the normally verdant plant life of Feralas into a withered brown. The hills have two caves, a small one towards the entrance and an ogre mound at the back of the area. Near the back cave is a captured sasquatch, Bigfist. Gordunni Hillguards, Gordunni Channelers and Gordunni Tamers roam the area.
